StikDebug is a separate app that attaches to Husk. Husk sends it the JIT script itself, so nothing needs configuring for Husk inside StikDebug.
Install [StikDebug](https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug/releases/latest).

Whenever Android starts, Husk opens StikDebug, which attaches and comes back.
TrollStore can enable JIT for apps it installed, with no pairing file, VPN or computer.
Install Husk.ipa through TrollStore, on an iOS version TrollStore supports. It carries the entitlements TrollStore keeps, so the same file works there and in a sideloader.
In TrollStore's Settings, turn on URL Scheme. TrollStore ignores enable-jit requests without it.
Whenever Android or a game starts, Husk asks TrollStore to enable JIT. TrollStore opens Husk, attaches to it for a moment and lets go, which leaves it allowed to run code it wrote.
TrollStore was not found on this \(device). Husk can only use it once it is installed and Husk was installed through it.
On a device jailbroken with Dopamine, JIT is a setting: the jailbreak marks every app as debugged when it opens, and a debugged app may run code it wrote. Husk needs nothing else.
Open Dopamine and go to its Settings.
Turn on Allow JIT in Apps.
Close Husk completely and open it again. The setting applies to apps as they start.
Husk was marked as debugged when it opened, so JIT is on.
